generate_key: generate an API key scoped to specific models and team_id via the key/generate endpoint
chat_completion: send a chat completion request to the chat/completions endpoint with a bearer key and model
test_generate_key: test the generate_key async function that creates API keys for specific models and teams
test_chat_completion: test the chat_completion async function that sends messages to the LiteLLM chat endpoint
review_test_team_logging: review the test helper functions for generating keys and sending chat completions in team logging tests
